checks: mouse first tap selects; second tap fires
touch first tap selects; second tap fires
pen first tap selects; second tap fires
mouse hover reacts once without selecting or firing
quick swipe visits crossed cells; release selects and later tap fires
out-and-back swipe on selected cupcake never fires on release
within-cell drag exceeding slop never confirms
outside release, empty cell, wall and spoiled cupcake cannot fire
secondary pointer cannot overwrite or release primary gesture
busy, result and intro block pointer reactions
reentering a cupcake during cooldown does not restart motion
scope: Real pointer handlers and game rules in a Node VM; native browser gestures and iOS hardware require separate checks.

browserChecks.gesture: Native mouse drag through the in-app browser
browserChecks.notes: Touch/pen pointer paths were checked in the VM. iOS hardware was not tested. Browser logs contained two MutationObserver.observe messages without source URLs; this API is absent from game source. No pointer-capture or gameplay failure was observed.
